title: RunManifest
description: run-manifest.json placed in each runs/<UTC>-<slug>/ directory. Describes the run: phase, lanes present, slices captured, and per-slice artifact filenames. Produced at run time or retrofitted for historical runs.

run_id.description: Directory name / run identifier (UTC timestamp + slug)

date.description: ISO 8601 date the run was captured

jsm_commit.description: JSM git commit SHA for JSM-lane runs; null if JSM was not used

steam_client.description: Steam client build ID for Steam-lane runs; null if Steam was not used

lanes.description: Which mapper lanes are present in this run

notes.description: Optional free-text notes about this run (anomalies, setup deviations)

verdict.description: Per-slice empirical verdict; null or 'blocked' if not yet classified

jsm_capture.description: Relative filename of the JSM-lane capture JSONL (e.g. 'taphold.capture.jsonl' or 'taphold.evdev.jsonl')

steam_capture.description: Relative filename of the Steam-lane XI2 capture JSONL (e.g. 'taphold.xi2.jsonl')

injector_log.description: Relative filename of the injector/holder log for stimulus-timestamp correlation
